The TEID field in the SRVCC PS to CS Request message header shall be set to "0" because this is the first message sent between the MME/SGSN and the MSC server to establish the tunnel for a UE. (according to 3GPP Rel-19, TS 29.280 v19.0.0)
There shall be one pair of TEID-C per UE on the Sv interface. (according to 3GPP Rel-19, TS 29.280 v19.0.0)
The MME/SGSN shall include the STN-SR information element for every SRVCC session, including emergency calls. (according to 3GPP Rel-19, TS 29.280 v19.0.0)
vSRVCC stands for Single Radio Voice Call Continuity. (according to 3GPP TS 29.280)
The Sv interface is used to support Inter-RAT handover from IMS based voice service over EPS to CS domain over 3GPP UTRAN/GERAN access. (according to 3GPP Rel-19, TS 29.280 v19.0.0)
Echo Request has Message Type value 25 on the Sv interface. (according to 3GPP Rel-19, TS 29.280 v19.0.0)
